premises.text: Drones cannot fly safely in up-close airspace near obstacles; they crash and each needs a skilled operator
premises.evidence_span: These drones do not have eyes and a brain, and they're only as capable as the operator on the ground, and they also require one operator for every drone.

premises.text: Guardian is a platform-agnostic sensor-software suite that automatically detects and avoids obstacles, overriding even operator error
premises.evidence_span: Our product called Guardian is a platform agnostic sensor software suite that automatically detects obstacles in the environment and avoids them.

premises.text: Go-to-market runs through partnerships with infrastructure-inspection commercial users who already want to fly
premises.evidence_span: We're going to market by partnering with major infrastructure inspection, commercial users that want to use drones today.

premises.text: An NSF-backed extension will also avoid other aircraft in the airspace, addressing a core FAA concern
premises.evidence_span: it will also avoid other aircraft in the airspace, solving one of the biggest problems the FAA has today

premises.text: A 20-customer, 90-day early-adopter program installs Guardian on site and shapes features from feedback
premises.evidence_span: we are launching our early adopter program and inviting 20 customers to work with us for 90 days

value.text: Companies unlock their aerial workforce as drones do useful work near obstacles without expert pilots
value.evidence_span: finally enable companies to unlock their aerial workforce

secondary_value.text: Inspector safety with better, faster infrastructure data
secondary_value.evidence_span: keep his feet safely on the ground and get better data faster than ever before

causal_links.evidence_span: Some companies are even trying to fly in this airspace now, and they are crashing everywhere.
will finally allow people that are not highly trained pilots to use drones
inspecting over 10,000 wind turbines a year using our system

notes: Industry-size framing (tens of thousands of drones, $98 billion) treated as market context, not a premise, per v1.3.2 clarification 4. Adjustable safety distance and swappable sensors folded into the Guardian premise per v1.3.2 clarification 5; the aircraft-avoidance SBIR work kept separate because it is a funded capability extension with its own FAA-facing rationale. No dependency coded: the extension is additive ('also avoid'), not asserted as a prerequisite. Team history and accelerator membership excluded per 4.2.
